Name: (CP) Prismatic Sprinkler Greenhouse
Author: NamelessPlayer06
Description:
This mod changes the greenhouse map to one designed for Prismatic Tool's sprinklers. it has a total of 12 squares for crop and a bunch of slots for trees.
It is about double the size of the original greenhouse.




This mod is [u]NOT[/u] compatible with any other mod that changes the greenhouse map!
